claim: Around 90 places to stay span both islands at roughly EUR30-480/night; Jul-Aug books out.
quote: There are 91 of the best hotels in Perhentian Island in 2026... price range from $30 a night to $400 a night.

claim: Indicative mid-June 2026 USD rates: Bubu Villa $514, BuBu Resort $362, Coral View $94, PIR $67.
quote: Online room rates at Bubu Villa start at US$514... BuBu Resort... US$362... Coral View Island Resort... US$94... Perhentian Island Resort... US$67 for a stay in mid-June 2026.

claim: Besar has a bigger, more spread-out, quieter range of resorts; Kecil is the developed backpacker island.
quote: Perhentian Besar has a bigger range of resorts. They are more spread out, and it's quieter... Perhentian Kecil is more developed and is known as a backpacker island.

claim: Ombak Resort on Coral Bay is couple-oriented with AC, wifi, breakfast and on-site bar; many resorts limit electricity to set hours.
quote: Ombak Resort Perhentian Island | Coral Bay | Couple-oriented | AC, Wi-Fi, breakfast included, onsite bar... Electricity often restricted to specific hours (mornings/evenings), though modern hotels offer 24-hour service.

claim: Price bands (RM120/250/600/1400 = approx EUR26/54/130/300); for comfort/romance choose Besar; book far ahead for Jul-Aug.
quote: $ = ~RM120/night (~EUR24)... $$$$+ = Over RM1400/night... For Comfort & Romance: Choose Perhentian Besar... Book far ahead for July-August. Avoid November-February (monsoon closures).

claim: Long Beach mixes backpacker shacks to expensive resorts; accommodation generally poor value for the standard.
quote: Long Beach is Kecil's best known beach and hosts a mix of backpacker shacks through to expensive resorts with little in between... Accommodation is generally poor value for the standards across the board.

claim: Crocodile Rock Villas offers wooden bungalows plus glamping, a new benchmark for upmarket Perhentian digs.
quote: Crocodile Rock Villas, nestled in the jungle midway between Coral Bay and Keranji Beach, offers a selection of superior wooden bungalows along with glamping, setting a new benchmark for upmarket Perhentian digs.

claim: Islands open March-October; essentially closed November-March due to monsoon with most hotels shut.
quote: The Perhentian Islands are officially open from March to October... November to March is the monsoon season when most of the services are closed.

claim: Beach season runs March-October, driest and best April-September.
quote: The official beach season on the Perhentians runs from March to October, but the driest months... are typically April to September.

claim: Islands open March-October and shut down outside those months for the monsoon.
quote: The Perhentian Islands are officially open from March to October, and outside of these months, the islands essentially shut down due to the monsoon season.

claim: EUR to MYR averaged about RM4.64 per euro in June 2026.
quote: Average EUR to MYR exchange rate in June 2026: EUR1 = RM 4.6415

claim: Tuna Bay Island Resort on Besar has beachfront chalets, a PADI 5-star dive centre, cafe/bar, house reef and breakfast/full-board packages.
quote: A PADI 5-star dive center operates on-site... beautiful house reefs that offer a memorable snorkeling experience just by the doorstep... packages include Room & Rate With Complimentary Breakfast and full-board options.

claim: Besar is best for couples seeking privacy; there are no ATMs (cash king); Tuna Bay is the best bet for location/quality/service; Mama's serves no alcohol.
quote: good for families and couples who seek privacy and alone time... There are still no ATMs on the Perhentian Islands, so cash is king... Tuna Bay Resort... the best bet for location, quality, and customer service.

claim: Alunan is an eco-boutique all-inclusive on Kecil with suites/poolside villas, unlimited dining/drinks, snorkel trips, sunset cruise and transfers, from RM509++ pp/night.
quote: Pricing: Starting from RM509++ per person/per night... Unlimited meals... Bottomless beverages... Yacht adventures and snorkeling excursions... Sunset Cruise: Included in the all-inclusive package.

claim: Alunan is a hillside boutique resort with many steps, not suitable for under-12s, seniors or wheelchairs.
quote: The resort is built on a hill with many steps and stairs; it is not suitable for wheelchair access, senior citizens, or children under the age of 12.

claim: BuBu Villa offers luxury villas with a private beach on Long Beach and best-rate guarantee on direct bookings.
quote: When booking directly on www.bubuvilla.com, you're guaranteed the best room rate, and if you find a lower price elsewhere, they will match that rate and give you an additional 20% off.

claim: BuBu Villa has 18 thatched-roof villas with private terraces at the southern end of Long Beach.
quote: BuBu Villa is located about 500 metres from BuBu Resort on the southern end of Long Beach, offering a collection of 18 single and luxury villas... private terrace and thatched roofs.

claim: BuBu Resort is an upscale beachfront resort on Long Beach, Perhentian Kecil.
quote: Bubu Long Beach Resort | Resort in Perhentian Island

claim: The Perhentian Marriott is a luxury island resort with rooms, villas and a spa.
quote: Perhentian Marriott Resort & Spa offers modern comforts and luxurious stays, from exquisite rooms to sweeping villas.

claim: The Marriott is on Perhentian Kecil with 3 outdoor pools, a full-service spa and 3 restaurants.
quote: The Perhentian Marriott Resort & Spa is a luxury hotel on Pulau Perhentian Kecil with 3 outdoor pools, a full-service spa, and 3 restaurants.

claim: The Marriott opened around 2024, sits a 4-minute walk from Long Beach, and rooms book between about $251 and $382.
quote: a 4-minute walk from Long Beach... celebrated their 2 years anniversary (as of June 2026), which indicates it opened around 2024... booked on KAYAK for between $251 and $382 in recent weeks.

claim: Marriott facilities rate well but many find it expensive and service below chain expectations.
quote: Many find the resort expensive relative to the experience... While facilities earn a high rating, the service does not match Marriott chain expectations, with staff lacking experience and training.

claim: Coral View Island Resort is on Perhentian Besar.
quote: Coral View Island Resort

claim: Coral View has a good house reef with turtles, rays, clownfish and parrotfish snorkellable off the beach.
quote: There is a good house reef around coral view with turtles, triggers, nemo's, rays, and parrot fish, where you can spend hours.

claim: Coral View shares Teluk Pauh, the best beach on Besar, white sand with a coral garden right in front.
quote: the best beach on Perhentian besar, white sandy beach and a good patch of coral garden right in front of the resort.

claim: Watercolours Resort & Dive Centre overlooks Turtle Bay on Besar, has 25 simple chalets and an on-site PADI dive centre.
quote: Watercolours Resort & Dive Centre overlooks Turtle Bay... comprises 25 rooms... Watercolours has a PADI Dive Centre with daily scuba diving trips and courses for all abilities.

claim: Mimpi Perhentian is a resort on Long Beach, Perhentian Kecil.
quote: Mimpi Perhentian - The Iconic Resort of Pulau Perhentian

claim: Mimpi has 75 rooms on Long Beach, a small salt-water pool with few loungers, spa and wifi; rooms RM1,200-3,000.
quote: Room prices range from RM1,200 per night... to RM3,000 per night... The hotel swimming pool is quite small... the hotel has limited deckchairs (just ten).

claim: Senja Bay Resort sits on Coral Bay, Perhentian Kecil, known for sunsets.
quote: Senja Bay Resort, Perhentian Island

claim: Senja Bay runs along southern Coral Bay with top sunset views and the only boat-restricted swim area there; AC sea-view chalets and wifi.
quote: Senja Bay runs along the southern edge of Coral Bay, enjoying some of the best sunset views... the only resort on coral bay that has a beach and water area that is restricted from boats.

claim: Shari-La in Coral Bay has a pool, AC, 24-hour electricity and hot showers, ~8 min walk to Long Beach, but inconsistent cleanliness.
quote: offering hot showers, satellite TV, mini bar, air-conditioning and 24-hour electricity... located at Pulau Perhentian Kecil (Coral Bay), 8 minutes walking distance to long beach.

claim: Crocodile Rock Villas is on the quieter west side of Perhentian Kecil.
quote: Pulau Perhentian accommodation | Crocodile Rock Villas | Malaysia

claim: Crocodile Rock has nine well-spaced villas plus glamping tents on Kecil's quiet west side; peaceful eco setting but rustic with some fan-only units and insects.
quote: nine units of private accommodation... beautifully designed cabanas and jungle safari tents... some units don't have air conditioning... guests have encountered ants, spiders and geckos.

claim: Perhentian Island Resort sits on Teluk Pauh beach, Perhentian Besar.
quote: Perhentian Island Resort - Island Palace

claim: PIR has turtles at the doorstep but reviews split between good snorkelling and old, poorly maintained rooms.
quote: The Turtles are easy to locate and snorkel with... However... The rooms are old and in a state of total abandonment, and nothing justifies the price.

claim: Teluk Pauh (Turtle Point) has a shallow seagrass bed with green turtles and parrotfish, calm and ideal for beginners.
quote: Teluk Pauh is also called Turtle Point because often turtles can be seen feeding on the seagrass bed near the Perhentian Island Resort's house reef. Green turtles... huge green humphead parrotfish can all be seen here.

claim: PIR and Coral View at Teluk Pauh offer the island's premier doorstep snorkelling; Tuna Bay has a reef off its jetty; Teluk Keke is the best shore-snorkel beach.
quote: Perhentian Island Resort (PIR) & Coral View Island Resort at Teluk Pauh offer the island's premier doorstep snorkeling... Teluk Keke (southwestern Perhentian Besar) ranks as the premier shore-accessible spot.

claim: Mama's Place on Besar is a quiet beachfront spot good for couples.
quote: Good for solo or couples travellers looking for a quiet and relaxing time... nice position on the beach, not very noisy.

claim: Mama's Chalet is among the best quality/price on Besar, warm and quiet, but the chalets are old and need renovation.
quote: Mama's Chalet is one of the best quality/price ratio places to stay in on Perhentian island besar... Chalet is very old and requires some renovation works.

claim: No ATMs and unreliable generator power; peak diving Jul-mid-Sep, almost everything closes mid-Nov to early March; price ranges from ~RM75 beach houses up.
quote: There are no ATMs on the islands... Avoid completely: Mid-November to early March (rainy season when almost all businesses close)... Peak season: July-mid-September (best diving, clearest water).

claim: Long Beach is Kecil's party hub with open-air bars, music and fire shows on the sand at night.
quote: Long Beach is the undisputed king of lively beaches on Perhentian Kecil, with many open-air bars and restaurants spilling across the sand... Fire shows, music, and beach bars create a festive vibe.

claim: Coral Bay is quieter and more relaxed than Long Beach, best for sunset and couples wanting to avoid the party scene.
quote: Coral Bay is quieter and more relaxed with fewer accommodation options... plan to post up on this side if you want to stay on Kecil but prefer to be removed from the party scene.

claim: The Barat on Besar's west beach was fully refurbished (new chalets 2024) with a PADI dive centre but has no pool.
quote: 39 units of newly built (in 2024) Seafront Family Chalets... a PADI Dive center... one reviewer mentioned that the resort Needs a pool.

claim: Arwana Perhentian Eco & Beach Resort is a beachfront Besar resort with eco branding and scuba/snorkel access.
quote: Arwana Perhentian Eco & Beach Resort offers a terrace, coffee shop, and garden... with a beachfront location featuring scuba diving and snorkeling opportunities.
